opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants

amount.raw: Our grants cover the cost of tuition fees, up to £1,820 per year for a full-time degree course.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students from low-income households who are ordinarily resident in Scotland, enrolled on an undergraduate degree course at an eligible Scottish institution, and not eligible for government funding for their tuition fees. Must be entitled to remain indefinitely in the UK, have limited leave to remain, or be an asylum seeker.
opportunities.summary: Grants covering the cost of tuition fees (up to £1,820 per year) for undergraduate students from low-income households who are ineligible for tuition fee support from the Scottish Government, including those who withdrew from study previously and some asylum seekers. Applications processed on a first-come-first-served basis.
